messages:
Alex: Heads-up — planning a quiet-window cutover for the engine kernel + quant bundle tonight 00:30 UTC. Targeting us-west1/us-east1. Need pin for old runtime, canary at 5% then ramp. Can someone own smoke? :alarm_clock:
Deploybot: scheduled rollout started: engine-v2.4.0-quant-kernel -> us-west1 at 00:30 UTC. Canary 5% (deploy-id: dpl-4821)
Tara: @Alex what are rollback thresholds? latency p95 + error rate?
Mike: Rollback if p95 > 120ms OR 5xx delta > 0.5% sustained 5m. Also watch kernel OOMs and KV cache thrash.
Sophia: I'll update release notes: add 'matmul kernel fixes, quant v3 fallback path, KV cache alignment'.
Jen: Telemetry checklist: request-rate, p95, 5xx, OOMs, kernel-mem-pressure. Post-deploy run this query:
```
SELECT p95_latency, error_rate FROM runtime_metrics WHERE deploy_id='dpl-4821' AND window='5m'
```
Mike: pin command I ran in staging, for prod it's:
`/deploy pin engine:2.4.0 --regions=us-west1,us-east1 --reason="overnight quiet-window kernel+quant"`
Alex: thx. Mike can you pick smoke? check embed correctness and kv cache hitrate.
Mike: On it, I'll run smoke suite at T+3m and watch telemetry.
Deploybot: canary at 5% traffic in us-west1 (dpl-4821). started 00:34 UTC.
Sophia: FYI — added release-note blurb in draft PR #184
Jen: seeing slight p95 bump in us-west1 (to 115ms) but within threshold. 5xx stable.
Mike: smoke passed for text-gen and embeddings in the canary pool.
Deploybot: ramp to 25% in us-west1 scheduled (manual approval required)
Alex: hold on ramp. give it another 10m for stable tails.
Jen: after 8m sustained, p95 slipped to 140ms and 5xx +0.9% over baseline. That's over our threshold.
Tara: recommend pause + rollback. We should also pin back to engine:2.3.8 for affected zones.
Alex: agree. Mike, execute rollback pin and notify ops.
Mike: running rollback now:
`/deploy rollback dpl-4821 --pin=engine:2.3.8 --regions=us-west1`
Deploybot: rollback initiated. unroute traffic from canary; pin applied engine:2.3.8 in us-west1. status: rolling back -> 100% old.
Jen: telemetry returning to baseline. p95 back to 95ms, 5xx delta -0.1%.
Alex: thanks everyone. We'll open a postmortem to triage kernel-quant interaction. Sophia — keep release notes draft; mark v2.4.0 as paused.
Sophia: will do. Creating a follow-up ticket to reproduce the 5xx spike with stress harness.
Tara: i'll schedule dev-time tomorrow to reproduce in staging with longer tails.
Alex: wrap up — add to release notes: paused rollout + rollback reason. Reconvene 9am PT. :white_check_mark:
